name: ladybug-tools-mcp
description: Run the local Ladybug Tools MCP server from this EnergyBuilding workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Local Ladybug Tools modeling and simulation for Codex
interface.longDescription: Starts the Ladybug Tools MCP server installed by scripts/install_ladybug_tools_mcp.sh and provides onboarding guidance for Garden setup, Honeybee modeling, simulation, visualization, and Flowerpot collaboration.
defaultPrompt: Create a new Garden for this project and build a simple Honeybee room with south-facing windows.
Search EPW data, download the weather file into my Garden, and start an energy simulation.
